summary: A plain-text detector finds links, dates, street addresses and phone numbers as byte ranges. There are no email, flight, money or tracking detectors, no typed match values, and no pasteboard detection.

features.feature: Match base type and string scanning
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/detect.rs (find, Kind, Match); wired: springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/parity.rs (Kind::Flight and Kind::Address now flagged by Check Spelling and Links)
features.note: returns kind plus byte range only; no typed payload per match Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity.
http, https and www; used for tappable links in Notes via springboard/src/shell/textarea.rs

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/detect.rs (Kind::Phone); wired: springboard/apps/calendar-desktop/src/calendar/notes.rs (phone), Target::CopyPhone in src/calendar.rs, share_copy in src/main.rs
features.note: range only, 7 to 15 digits; no parsed number value Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.
street plus house number, English and Icelandic; no components (city, postcode)

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/detect.rs (Kind::Date); wired: springboard/apps/calendar-desktop/src/calendar/quick.rs (parse), Calendar::new_event_from_text in src/calendar.rs, File > New Event from Text in src/main.rs
features.note: only yyyy-mm-dd and d.m.yyyy; no times, ranges or relative dates Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.
